newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aznar says Spain plans to enter EMU in first wave.
newsitem.headline: Aznar says Spain plans to enter EMU in first wave.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar on Tuesday reiterated Spain's determination to be among the first wave of countries to launch European economic and monetary union (EMU).
"Spain and the Spanish government have decided to take part in the single currency from the beginning," he told a news conference after talks with his Dutch counterpart Wim Kok.
Aznar said Spanish government policy was directed towards satisfying the convergence criteria for monetary union and said he did not have the least doubt that it would do so.
He was speaking after more than two hours of talks with Kok about European Union and bilateral issues.
The Netherlands holds the European Union presidency in the first half of 1997 and hopes to draft a treaty on EU reform in time for it to be signed at a June summit in Amsterdam.
